## Functions

### `SplitLayout`

```ts
SplitLayout(props: SplitLayoutProps): Html
```

Master/detail two-pane frame; one pane at a time on phones.

## Types

### `SplitLayoutProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `header` | `Html` |  |  |
| `pane` | `Html` | yes | The master pane (a list). Gets a stable id so it can be swapped. |
| `paneId` | `string` |  |  |
| `content` | `Html` | yes | The detail. |
| `contentId` | `string` |  |  |
| `mobileView` | `"pane" | "detail"` |  | Which pane a phone shows — a route decision (e.g. `/inbox` → list, `/inbox/42` → detail). The detail should carry its own back link. |
| `stickyHeader` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |
